class.name: JustAMCPMCPClientBridge
class.brief_description: MCP tools for bridging to remote MCP servers.
class.description: Exposes tools that list configured bridges, discover remote tools, and forward tool or resource calls to allow-listed remote MCP endpoints. Used by [JustAMCPToolExecutor] when MCP client bridging is enabled.

method.name: execute_tool
method.description: Executes the MCP client-bridge tool named by [param tool_name] with [param arguments] and returns the tool response dictionary.

method.name: provide_tool_schemas
method.description: Returns MCP JSON schema dictionaries for client-bridge tools. Set [param register_only] for registration metadata only, or [param ignore_settings] to bypass editor filtering.
